ऋचेयु

ṚCEYU . A king of the pūru Dynasty.1) Genealogy. From viṣṇu were descended in the following order:-brahmā-atri-candra-budha-purūravas. ĀyusNahuṣa. yayāti-pūru-janamejaya-prācinvān-PravīraNamasyu-vītabhaya-śuṇḍu-bahuvidha-saṁyāti-rahovādī-raudrāśva and ṛceyu.

(2 Other details.
(i) His mother, miśrakeśī was a goddess. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 94, Verse 10).(ii) He had two other names; anvagbhānu and Anāvṛṣṭi. matināra was the son of ṛceyu. (M.B. Ādi Parva. Chapter 94, Verses 11-13).
